briefing.heading: Tasking
briefing.text: Seize data or cargo. Reach the objective, take what it holds, and get it out.

briefing.heading: Situation
briefing.text: Freespace Solutions and Contractors hold a desert position. Data or cargo the force needs is in sector B3. The holders will move it soon.

briefing.heading: Objective
briefing.text: Sector B3. A model in base contact may Interact to take it: automatic for a model with a hacking rig (data) or Physique 2 or more (cargo); 2d6 + Tech (data) or Physique (cargo), 8+, for anyone else. Data travels with the model that copied it; cargo is carried, and the carrier has −2" Move. If the carrier goes Down, a model in base contact may take it with an Interact.

briefing.heading: Opposition
briefing.text: Freespace Solutions and Contractors, threat tier 3. Guard (known): Borz Bratva team (3 models), at the objective, Unaware. Contacts (unknown): 5 chips.

briefing.heading: Ground
briefing.text: Desert, badlands, 36" × 36" table (3 × 3 sectors). Conditions: Clear: No effect.

briefing.heading: Complication
briefing.text: Reinforced: One more contact than the tier lists.

briefing.heading: Extraction and time
briefing.text: Out by the player's own edge. Enemy entry and exit: middle of the far edge. Small mission: 20 minutes, clock die d4. Check-ins every 5 minutes from minute 10. Alert track starts at 0.

briefing.heading: Grades
briefing.text: Decisive: Objective extracted and no player model Dead. Marginal: Objective extracted. Failure: Objective not extracted when time runs out.
